title: Preserve relational automatic-transaction intent
goal: Preserve automatic transaction and rollback behavior when replacing an obsolete transaction switch.

selectionNotes: EF10 AutoTransactionsEnabled=true selects WhenNeeded, not Always (measured by an old-boolean-only single-command save with zero transaction starts); false selects Never. EF11 removes that boolean. AutoTransactionBehavior already exists in EF10 and is a valid migration before upgrading. Never can leave earlier commands committed after a later command fails. WhenNeeded wraps the multi-command save; Always also starts a transaction for a single command. The fixture forces separate commands with MaxBatchSize(1), rejects the second insert with a CHECK constraint and reads persisted IDs through a fresh context. Separate single-command saves measure TransactionStarted. No ambient/explicit transaction, retry strategy, Cosmos mode or distributed atomicity guarantee.

packageAssets: Exact independently locked SQL Server/SQLite graphs; Current supported route: .NET/SDK11, C#15 and matching EF11 packages. Measured SDK11.0.100-rc.3.26522.148, EF11.0.0-rc.2.26504.105 versus SDK10.0.403, C#14, runtime10.0.13 and EF10.0.13. Stable API shapes on RC2 are not GA proof. EF11/Core/Relational select net11.0; direct Sqlite11 selects net10.0. EF10 selects net10.0 and direct Sqlite10 net8.0. SQL Server provider uses SqlClient6.1.7 versus7.1.0; locked graphs pin Pkcs10.0.13. Windows x64 native SQLite3.53.3/SQLitePCLRaw2.1.13 versus3.53.4/3.0.5. Both native hashes/source IDs are recorded. No older-runtime EF11 route, new .NET10 foundation, encryption, other OS/provider, Cosmos transaction or GA claim. No workload, rendering mode or experimental opt-in applies.

prerequisites: PowerShell7, both pinned SDKs, running approved local SQL2025 Docker route and NuGet restore. Use eng/Test-AlderQueries.ps1; it injects credentials only in the child environment. Never print credentials. Copy the complete independent projects. Restore before offline execution.

evidence.scope: Run eng/Test-AlderQueries.ps1 -Record with the approved SQL2025 Docker route. It compiles both independent locked graphs, records fresh input hashes/dependencies/SDK/runtime, creates unique restricted databases, runs real SQL and native SQLite checks, and removes owned databases/logins in finally. behavior.evidence.json retains SQL, parameter values, runtime checks and compile-only diagnostics. verification-evidence.json retains compilation. Never execute DiagnosticProbe: it deliberately contains insecure compiler controls. Actual installed offline stdio inspection separately verifies discovery, full canonical body, target11/edition11, applicability and evidence. Unusable retrieval proxies prove proxy independence, not OS network isolation. PIN-959/PIN-965 and existing Human gates remain open.
